identifier.name: installationId
identifier.persistence: until storage is cleared or the extension is removed
identifier.purpose: installation measurement and short-lived API abuse budgeting

source: visible purchase block and its package identity
Steam page market and language context
read: displayed Steam price in minor units
sent: App ID and Package ID in the request path
displayed Steam price and surface in request parameters
flows.browserStorage: bounded short response cache in session storage or service-worker memory
flows.purpose: return a comparison for the Steam page the user opened
flows.retention: The extension cache expires after two minutes for positive results and 30 seconds for negative results. The request-scoped comparison context is not written to extension local storage.

read: displayed final price in minor units
must purchase as a set flag
sent: the six fields in security/main-world-schema.json via same-window postMessage
flows.destination: isolated extension script on the same Steam wishlist page
flows.purpose: provide the package identity that Steam does not expose in the visible wishlist row
flows.retention: The bridge keeps no copy after publishing. The isolated script validates the message against the visible wishlist row before an API request.

source: random installation UUID generated by the extension
sent: { iid: random UUID v4 } to POST /v2/extension/session
flows.browserStorage: session token in storage.session when available, otherwise service-worker memory; never storage.local
flows.purpose: support short-lived request continuity; the token is not an authentication credential
flows.retention: The short-lived token is kept in session storage or memory and expires within six hours. It is not saved in local extension storage.

source: random installation UUID and random event UUID
sent: POST { event_id: random UUID v4, iid: installation UUID } to /v2/extension/analytics/install from the service worker
the same iid and event_id in the first-party installation page URL fragment
flows.browserStorage: installation UUID in extension local storage; install and uninstall navigation uses a URL fragment
flows.purpose: measure extension installation and, where the browser supports it, uninstallation
flows.retention: The extension does not keep a separate copy of the request after sending it. See Stan's privacy page for related information.

source: merchant category choices in the extension UI
flows.browserStorage: storage.sync when available; falls back to storage.local if absent or unusable
flows.purpose: filter displayed offers according to the user's choices
flows.retention: Until cleared by the user or removed with the extension. The extension does not promise cross-device synchronization, especially for Safari.

source: user selects an offer displayed by the extension
read: the selected opaque Stan action URL
sent: browser navigation to the first-party Stan action URL
flows.purpose: open the offer selected by the user
flows.retention: The extension does not retain this navigation in browser extension storage.

notCollectedByExtension: Steam access tokens or wishlist request URLs
checkout form contents or payment details
networkMetadata: Requests include standard browser connection information. See Stan's privacy page for information about network and service-provider processing.
